verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is itself an AI coding agent, so it fills the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows only client-side MCP connectors (e.g., a GitHub MCP connector that lets Bolt read issues and pull requests), which belong to the MCP-client story and are not credited here. Nothing shows Bolt running as an MCP server, such as a serve command or a hosted MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
